items.name: Rounded boucle sofa
items.description_en: a modern three-seat sofa upholstered in ivory cream boucle fabric (#ece4d6), soft rounded modular blocks, deep seat cushions, low rounded arms, a slim recessed plinth, two loose boucle cushions

items.name: Cognac leather sofa
items.description_en: a mid-century modern three-seat sofa in smooth cognac brown leather (#9a5a32) with horizontal channel-tufted back cushions, slim straight arms, a thin solid walnut base frame on four tapered walnut legs

items.name: Sage linen sofa
items.description_en: a contemporary three-seat sofa upholstered in washed sage green linen (#8a9a82), deep loose seat and back cushions with soft piping, square low arms, short dark oak block legs

items.name: Round travertine coffee table
items.description_en: a round coffee table carved from honed beige travertine stone (#d9c7a9) with visible natural pores and veining, a thick round top on one wide drum-shaped pedestal base of the same stone

items.name: Oval walnut coffee table
items.description_en: an oval solid walnut coffee table (#6b4630) with a softly bevelled top edge, a lower open shelf, four short rounded legs, natural matte oiled wood grain

items.name: Oval oak dining table
items.description_en: an oval dining table in natural light oak (#c49a6c) with a thick top and two sculpted solid oak trestle legs that taper towards the floor, matte oiled finish, no chairs

items.name: White marble dining table
items.description_en: a rectangular dining table with a white Carrara marble top (#ebe8e3) with soft grey veining and rounded corners, on a slim black powder-coated steel frame with four thin legs, no chairs

items.name: Oak and boucle dining chair
items.description_en: a dining chair with a solid light oak frame (#c49a6c), a curved oak backrest band and a cream boucle upholstered seat (#ece4d6), four slightly splayed round legs, one chair only
